intro: Across 67 articles dated 2026-04-12 to 2026-10-21, ZCyberNews' ransomware coverage tracks LockBit, ShinyHunters, and The Gentlemen. Reporting spans CVE-2026-1731 (CVSS 9.8), CVE-2026-34197 (CVSS 8.8), CVE-2020-3259, CVE-2023-20269, and CVE-2023-27532. Government, healthcare, manufacturing, multiple, and technology sectors appear among affected victims. Coverage reaches the United states, North america, Global, Europe, and Germany. The severity mix comprises 47 high, 6 critical, 1 medium, and 2 informational items.
